root_cause.conclusion: MMS-AUD-003 described a real historical saved-source defect, but the finding's current-runtime attribution is stale. An activated Cargo preview DOM was serialized back into Home source, carrying runtime state onto native rivers. Round 84 restored the clean gold Home source, and Round 85 added a fail-closed saved-source purity gate. The current canonical source, generated bodycopy, public response, and live DOM are clean.
